hypotheses.T0_analytic_jvp_recomposes_native_path: The analytic final-MLP JVP recomposes the saved native backward-path effect to relative error at most 1e-5.
hypotheses.T1_output_write_basis_is_compact: A discovery-frozen rank-64 natural-write basis alone retains at least 0.95 of every endpoint on held-out FineWeb and both OOD corpora.
hypotheses.T2_role_separated_rank64_recovers_scores: The rank-64 context/tangent/output quotient retains at least 0.80 of prediction and target effects on every corpus.
hypotheses.T3_role_separated_rank64_recovers_margin: The rank-64 role-separated quotient retains at least 0.70 of the precision-sensitive margin effect on every corpus.
hypotheses.T4_role_separated_rank128_is_sufficient: The rank-128 role-separated quotient retains at least 0.90 of prediction and target and at least 0.80 of margin on every corpus.
hypotheses.T5_role_separation_beats_shared_pca: At rank 64, the role-separated quotient exceeds the shared-state-PCA quotient by at least 0.20 for prediction and target and 0.30 for margin on every corpus.
hypotheses.T6_role_assignment_matters: At rank 64, the correctly assigned quotient exceeds the context/tangent-swapped quotient by at least 0.10 in mean fidelity across endpoints on every corpus.
hypotheses.T7_role_quotient_beats_random: At rank 64, every endpoint exceeds the matched random-quotient 95th percentile by at least 0.20 on every corpus.
hypotheses.T8_role_quotient_transfers_ood: At rank 64, no OOD endpoint falls more than 0.15 below held-out FineWeb.
hypotheses.T9_contracted_tensor_is_exact: The contracted rank-64 context-by-tangent-by-output tensor matches the projected native CP computation to relative error at most 1e-5.
hypotheses.T10_validation_split_is_not_fit: The bases are fit on the first 192 discovery sites and all selection diagnostics are also reported on the disjoint final 64 discovery sites.
